evidence.activity: Sells HCM and payroll software platforms built for small and medium-sized businesses (SurePayroll for self-service small businesses, Paychex Flex for SMBs)
evidence.quote: SurePayroll® serves the digitally driven small business self-service market. Paychex Flex® is our proprietary HCM SaaS platform for small and medium-sized businesses.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Our Solutions > Management Solutions > HCM technology

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 3: named business software built for small businesses, described by management as its proprietary core HCM platform (substantial reach shown by centrality to the business)

evidence.activity: Subsidiary provides accounts-receivable funding (factoring) to small businesses
evidence.quote: Alterna Capital Solutions, LLC, offers funding to small businesses through the purchase of outstanding accounts receivable balances under non-recourse agreements.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Our Solutions > Management Solutions > Funding solutions

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: ordinary small-business financing, counts as serving only

evidence.activity: Employee benefits that include tuition assistance, scholarships for employees' children and financial education
evidence.quote: We regularly review employee salaries to ensure we are competitive in the industry and offer financial benefits such as a 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance, scholarships for children of employees, and financial education.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Comprehensive Compensation and Benefits

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Sponsors Red Cross blood donation events and other well-being programs at company sites
evidence.quote: In addition, we sponsor onsite health screenings, Red Cross blood donation events, flu vaccination clinics, vaping and tobacco cessation and weight management programs, meditation and yoga classes, and a variety of other programs.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Employee Well-being Initiatives

community.criterion: level 2: specific current community activity with limited reach, no figures

evidence.activity: Annual Paychex Culture Day: an extra paid day off for employees to observe a holiday significant to their heritage
evidence.quote: Annually, we celebrate Paychex Culture Day, an additional paid day off for employees to celebrate and recognize a holiday that is significant to them.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Employee Well-being Initiatives

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific inclusive benefit, no reach figures

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers HCM, payroll, benefits and insurance solutions and shows no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 2: the filing shows employee development (tuition assistance, scholarships) and a small community activity (blood drives) with no reach figures, and its customer webinars and resources count as marketing-style customer education.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: one specific current inclusive practice (Paychex Culture Day) with no reach figures; other inclusion language is general.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 3: named small-business HCM software (SurePayroll, Paychex Flex) is central to the business, but no customer or revenue figures are broken out for it, so level 4 is not met.

ai.notes: Human Capital section refers investors to the Corporate Responsibility website and report, but it also describes specific activities and runs well over 150 words, so Community and Cross-cultural coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. Entrepreneurship is borderline between 2 and 3. The 800,000 payroll-client and 840,000 total-customer figures cover businesses of all sizes, appear in other paragraphs, and are not attributed to the SMB platforms, so they were not used as indicators. Payroll processing, insurance for small businesses, and Alterna factoring are treated as serving. Traps excluded: annual 'Right Way' values training (compliance-type training); free webinars, white papers, Paychex WORX and Paycor HR Center for Excellence (educating customers as marketing); Small Business Employment Watch reports (information, not an enabling service); Talent management modules that let customers enroll their employees in training (a product feature, not company-run education); 'Partnership' value and AICPA/broker partnerships (commercial distribution deals); 'Innovation' value and AI/WISE (own innovation). 'Inclusive culture' language and the inclusion survey topic are general statements. Paycor acquisition completed April 14, 2025.
